about: Experience the abstract yet dangerous world of Prismatic Solid through its simple shapes and geometric aesthetic. Swim through a torrent of bullets in this stylish top down vertical shooter as you dodge flashing lasers, debris from explosions, and fluttering embers.

A wide array of weapons and unlockable upgrades are at your disposal, with many drastically altering the structure of your artillery. Featuring music by master game music composers Shinji Hosoe and Ayako Saso.
